svg.title: H2Matrices.jl development roadmap for FEM micromagnetics
svg.desc: Four-phase roadmap showing how to build an H2 matrix library on top of HMatrices.jl for use in large-mesh FEM micromagnetic modeling

g.text: O(N) matvec: upward pass → translation → downward pass
Strict linear complexity — eliminate the log factor from HMatrices.jl
Assemble dense BEM matrix B as H² — target 99% compression at N = 10⁶
Validation against tetmag / Nmag reference solutions
muMAG standard problems — coercivity, switching, vortex dynamics
Target: N = 10⁷ – 10⁸ DOF on HPC cluster
Grain structures, exchange-coupled multilayers, 3D skyrmion lattices
Deliverable: H2Matrices.jl v1.0 — registered Julia package
